display_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-07-D3-17 PV based electrification of the economy: Designing & optimising PV systems supporting industrial electrification and promoting participation in electricity markets (EUPI-PV Partnership) – Horizon Europe
call_module_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-07-D3-17 PV based electrification of the economy: Designing & optimising PV systems supporting industrial electrification and promoting participation in electricity markets (EUPI-PV Partnership)
executive_summary: Demonstrates high-voltage DC solar systems for industrial sites or pooling PV with other assets to provide balancing and electricity-market services. Eligible consortium beneficiaries can receive up to 70% for for-profit beneficiaries under Horizon Europe. The indicative topic budget is EUR 18 million, with around EUR 6 million expected per project. Opening 2027-08-04, full proposal deadline 2027-12-01 at 17:00 Brussels time.
status_rationale: Work Programme Part 8, pp. 154–157, Scope and Specific conditions, funds this work, which connects to ARTeMIS. Annex B permits Dutch company beneficiaries. In Scope 2, a funded TSO role is credible for testing pooled PV participation in balancing, subject to the China-control restriction. The funded consortium role supports Type 1 and C1.3. The helper supplied both project dates from 1 January 2027 using its 36-month default.
